command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/srv-data-lvm.img
loopdev=$(losetup -j "$backing" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
    loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$backing")
fi
lvmdevices --adddev "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay srvvg >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop backing store for /srv/data LVM volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs.target shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
mkdir -p /srv/data
if ! grep -Fq '/dev/srvvg/data /srv/data ' /etc/fstab; then
    printf '%s\n' '/dev/srvvg/data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-loop.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
printf 'CONFIGURED\n'
tail -n 3 /etc/fstab
systemctl cat srv-data-loop.service
